precommitted_interpretation_checks: GAAP operating income rises 350808 USD thousand; the disposition-gain credit grows 343624 USD thousand. The exact accounting bridge leaves only 7184 USD thousand of the reported operating-income change outside that gain line, which is not proof of sustainable core improvement.

The source-reported non-GAAP adjusted operating income rises 40080 USD thousand, from 1052749 to 1092829. It includes discontinued operations per the release's definition, while the displayed GAAP operating line belongs to the continuing-operations statement. Do not treat these deltas as like-for-like profitability measures.

GAAP net income attributable to Global Payments rises 393569 USD thousand; discontinued-operations income rises 153317 USD thousand. Do not label the entire attributable-income increase as continuing-business improvement.
The displayed quarterly cells are USD thousands, not USD millions. Parentheses on gain and noncontrolling-interest lines denote signed negative amounts within the GAAP statement.
A selected-row arithmetic bridge and adjacent-quarter change do not establish causal durability, valuation or a trade.
